summary: An education dispute brings strikers out during a term that has gone well in other areas.
realLife: During West Virginia’s 2018 teachers’ strike, high school teacher Katie Endicott explained why a larger pay offer had yet to bring her back to class. The freeze on the employee health plan left her family’s future costs unsettled.
inGame: needs: read the education-specific grievance and the term’s other outcomes alongside the recorded strike.

turns.what: The education dispute reaches a settlement after the term ends.
turns.pulledBy: The negotiating parties are still meeting when the successor takes office.
turns.writesBack: The strike and settlement fall under different terms.

turns.what: Teachers return to classrooms after a pay agreement while the dispute over insurance goes back to committee.
turns.pulledBy: The signed agreement covers salaries and assigns benefits to a later hearing.
turns.writesBack: The school calendar resumes and the benefits question stays on the legislative agenda.
